title: Training LLMs to Follow Reasoning Instructions with Minimal Edits
abstract: arXiv:2611.26342v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models increasingly rely on extended reasoning traces, yet the training signals used to shape this behavior remain coarse. Supervised fine-tuning on full trajectories forces the model to imitate an entire demonstration, overconstraining its output distribution, while trajectory-level reinforcement learning provides only weak credit assignment, rewarding or penalizing whole completions without identifying where they succeed or fail. We propose edit-based training, a general framework for learning from a model's own trajectories via localized textual corrections. Given a sampled completion, an editor identifies the first point of failure under a specified criterion and proposes a minimal replacement span. The model is then supervised only on these edited spans. translated_title: 通过最小编辑训练大语言模型遵循推理指令
translated_abstract: 大语言模型日益依赖扩展的推理轨迹，然而用于塑造这种行为的训练信号仍然较为粗糙。对完整轨迹进行监督微调会迫使模型模仿整个演示，过度约束其输出分布；而轨迹级强化学习只能提供较弱的信用分配，对整个完成结果进行奖励或惩罚，却无法识别其具体在何处成功或失败。我们提出了基于编辑的训练，这是一种通过局部文本修正从模型自身轨迹中学习的通用框架。给定一个采样得到的完成结果，编辑器在指定标准下识别出首个失败点，并提出一个最小的替换片段。随后，模型仅在这些被编辑的片段上进行监督训练。通过这一设计，监督被集中在模型推理首次出现问题的位置，同时旨在保留其余部分已有的推理模式。该方法适用……
tldr: 提出基于编辑的训练框架，通过定位模型推理轨迹中首个失败点并进行最小文本修正，仅对编辑片段施加监督，从而在保留已有推理模式的同时更精准地训练大语言模型遵循推理指令。
en_tdlr: Proposes edit-based training, a framework that identifies the first point of failure in a model's own reasoning trajectory and supervises only minimal edited spans, enabling more precise training of LLMs to follow reasoning instructions while preserving existing reasoning patterns.
